text: In the 2024/2025 period, 3,664 individuals were enrolled, with FJD 2.47 million in protection and over FJD 107,000 paid out to vulnerable communities. An early tranche saw 1,013 farmers receive FJD 201,000, with 74% of farmers affected, 40% women, and 24% people with disabilities. 87% of surveyed beneficiaries used payouts to restart livelihoods, with payouts occurring within approximately two weeks post-verification.
